name: @plugin/slides
description: Linnya Slides 官方 runtime 插件包

scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:raster-worker && pnpm run build:brush-worker && pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:cli
scripts.smoke:raster-worker: pnpm run build:raster-worker && pnpm run build:raster-preload && node ../../../scripts/build/run-esbuild.mjs dev/tools/rasterWorkerSmoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/dev/raster-worker-smoke.cjs --format=cjs --external:electron --external:sharp --alias:@plugin/backend/hiddenWorkerRuntime=../../../src/electron-main/hidden-worker/standaloneHiddenWorkerRuntime.ts --alias:@plugin/backend/imageInspection=../../../src/plugin-sdk/backend/imageInspection.ts --alias:@plugin/backend/imageTranscoding=../../../src/plugin-sdk/backend/imageTranscoding.ts --alias:@plugin/backend/fontResolution=../../../src/plugin-sdk/backend/fontResolution.ts --alias:@plugin/backend/textMeasurement=../../../src/plugin-sdk/backend/textMeasurement.ts --tsconfig=tsconfig.json && cp src/backend/codegen/compose/flex-layout/yogaRuntimeLoader.cjs dist/dev/yogaRuntimeLoader.cjs && cp ../../../src/features/text-measurement/infrastructure/system/harfbuzzRuntimeLoader.cjs dist/dev/harfbuzzRuntimeLoader.cjs && electron dist/dev/raster-worker-smoke.cjs
scripts.smoke:brush-worker: pnpm run build:brush-worker && pnpm run build:backend && node ../../../scripts/build/run-esbuild.mjs dev/tools/brushArtworkWorkerSmoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/dev/brush-artwork-worker-smoke.cjs --format=cjs --external:electron --external:sharp --alias:@plugin/backend/hiddenWorkerRuntime=../../../src/electron-main/hidden-worker/standaloneHiddenWorkerRuntime.ts --tsconfig=tsconfig.json && electron dist/dev/brush-artwork-worker-smoke.cjs
scripts.validate:svg-phase0: pnpm run typecheck:svg-phase0 && node ../../../scripts/build/run-esbuild.mjs dev/tools/svgPhase0Validation.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/dev/svg-phase0-validation.cjs --format=cjs --external:electron --external:sharp --external:pptxgenjs --external:jszip --external:@xmldom/xmldom --tsconfig=tsconfig.json && electron dist/dev/svg-phase0-validation.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.brush-worker.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.smoke:preview-transitions: vue-tsc --noEmit -p dev/tsconfig.preview-transitions.json && vite build --config vite.preview-smoke.config.mts && node ../../../scripts/build/run-esbuild.mjs dev/tools/previewTransitionSmoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist/dev/preview-transition-smoke.cjs --format=cjs --external:electron --tsconfig=tsconfig.json && electron dist/dev/preview-transition-smoke.cjs
